name: npm install
cmd: npm rebuild --foreground-scripts; for s in preinstall install postinstall prepare; do npm run --if-present $s; done
why: install runs lifecycle scripts of the project and its dependencies

name: npm run start
why: the take-home asks you to start the app
stdout:
> warehouse-api@1.0.0 start
> node src/server.js
